sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.734 of 2025 pending on the file of learned Court of the SDJM, Pallahara, arising out of Pallahara P.S. Case No.341 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(1) of I.P.C. read with Section 67(A)/66(E)
of the I.T. Act.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary.
4. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioner shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
5. It is needless to say that the Petitioner shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.
(V. NARASINGH) Vacation Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
